claim: Patchline turns accepted user-submitted examples into pinned public proof entries through a deterministic, auditable pipeline that refuses to admit anything that is not reproducible. Each submission must name a capability that maps to an existing gate, a public repository, and a pinned ref (a 40-character commit SHA or an explicit tag ref); submissions that are unpinned, name an unknown capability, or lack a claim are rejected with a structured reason. The gate proves that valid submissions become proof entries and that a deliberately unpinned negative-control submission is always rejected.
